questions.question: After Jesus gave a teaching many of His disciples found difficult, what did many of them do?

answers.text: Turned back and stopped walking with Him
Stayed and asked Him to explain it
Went back to the synagogue to argue

questions.question: When Jesus asked the Twelve if they wanted to leave, Peter said they believed Jesus was who?
Jesus said one of His twelve chosen men was a devil. Which man was He speaking about?
When many disciples grumbled about His teaching, Jesus said no one can come to Him unless what?

answers.text: The Father has granted it to him
He keeps every law of Moses
He was born a son of Abraham
